description:
Our team is tackling the challenge: "Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars."

Our mission is to breathe new life into the legacy of deep-space exploration. Decades of historical missions have left behind rovers, landers, and equipment across the lunar and Martian surfaces. Rather than treating these objects as mere space debris, we are building an immersive storytelling platform
summary:
**Echoes on the Moon** is an interactive educational experience that brings the history of human exploration of the Moon to life through an immersive digital environment. The project focuses on NASA's Apollo lunar landing missions, allowing users to explore the Moon, discover Apollo landing sites, and learn about the astronauts, missions, discoveries, and technologies that shaped lunar exploration.

Instead of presenting Apollo history as static text, Echoes on the Moon combines interactive storytelling, 3D visualization, historical information, and guided exploration to make lunar exploration more engaging and accessible. Through the experience, users can travel through the story of Apollo missions and understand how each mission contributed to humanity's knowledge of the Moon.

The project aims to make space science and exploration easier to understand for students and general audiences while encouraging curiosity about NASA's missions and the history of human space exploration.
details:
Echoes on the Moon is an interactive educational experience that brings the history of human exploration of the Moon to life through an immersive digital environment. The project focuses on NASA's Apollo lunar missions and allows users to explore the Moon, discover Apollo landing sites, and learn about the astronauts, missions, discoveries, and technologies that contributed to lunar exploration.

The project works by combining an interactive 3D representation of the Moon with clickable Apollo landing locations and educational content. Users can explore different landing sites and discover information about the corresponding missions, astronauts, objectives, and important events. Interactive characters such as Nova and Luna are designed to guide users through the experience and make complex space-science concepts easier and more engaging to understand.

The main benefit of Echoes on the Moon is that it transforms traditional, text-heavy space education into an interactive experience. Instead of simply reading about Apollo missions, users can visually explore the Moon and interact with information at their own pace. This can make lunar exploration more accessible and interesting for students, space enthusiasts, and anyone who wants to learn about humanity's journey to the Moon.

The intended impact of the project is to encourage curiosity about space science and inspire users to learn more about lunar exploration, NASA missions, and the scientific discoveries made through the Apollo program. We want users to leave the experience with a better understanding of why these missions were important and how they contributed to our knowledge of the Moon.

The project was developed using React, TypeScript, Vite, Three.js, and React Three Fiber, along with HTML and CSS for the web interface and styling. Git and GitHub are used for source-code management and version control. AI-assisted development tools were also used during the development process for coding assistance, brainstorming, and organizing parts of the project where applicable.

Creativity is a central part of the project. Rather than presenting Apollo history as a conventional webpage, Echoes on the Moon combines 3D visualization, interactive storytelling, educational content, and guided exploration. The Moon itself becomes the starting point for discovering the stories behind the missions.

While developing the project, our team considered educational value, ease of use, visual engagement, accessibility, historical accuracy, technical performance, and the clarity of the information presented. We aimed to create an experience that is visually appealing while still keeping the educational purpose of the project at its center.
